description: A Minecraft mod to make Minecraft more immersive!

mods.name: ImmersiveMC
mods.description:
Minimizes the need to interact with GUIs in Minecraft!

Works great both in and out of VR!

Thanks to NahNotFox for the bundle bag model (the default) and the written book texture!

Thanks to:
- halfstorm for porting ImmersiveMC to 1.21.10!
- andreiqwer for adding support for resizing item guides and a bugfix!
- Blocker226 for fixing Z-fighting issues on several Immersives!
- yaosiqian for Simplified Chinese translations!
- Yermak for the Russian translations!
- DadoSpeedy for the German translations!
- Detective Scar for the Dutch translations!

Thanks to the Vivecraft developers for inspiration for the bag, and to various members of the ImmersiveMC Discord for ideas!

Thanks to the guide from leo3418 for the original config screen implementation!

Minimizes the need to interact with GUIs in Minecraft!

Works great both in and out of VR!

Thanks to NahNotFox for the bundle bag model (the default) and the written book texture!

Thanks to:
- halfstorm for porting ImmersiveMC to 1.21.10!
- andreiqwer for adding support for resizing item guides and a bugfix!
- Blocker226 for fixing Z-fighting issues on several Immersives!
- yaosiqian for Simplified Chinese translations!
- Yermak for the Russian translations!
- DadoSpeedy for the German translations!
- Detective Scar for the Dutch translations!

Thanks to the Vivecraft developers for inspiration for the bag, and to various members of the ImmersiveMC Discord for ideas!

Thanks to the guide from leo3418 for the original config screen implementation!

releases.notes:
## Major Changes

- Players now see the open bags of other players in multiplayer.
- Added support for Minecraft 26.2

## Minor Changes

- Players can now drag across multiple slots of the bag crafting area.

## Bugs Fixed

- Fixed an issue where ImmersiveMC would crash without Vivecraft installed.
- Fixed an issue where each half of a double chest Immersive would show the contents of the other half.

## Technical Changes

- Player-attachment Immersives (such as the bag) have been refactored to share a common base with block-based Immersives internally. This refactored system is exposed to other mod developers via ImmersiveMC's API. For migrating to this API version, check out [the new migration page on ImmersiveMC's new wiki](https://immersivemcwiki.hammy275.com/api/migration_guide/#40-immersivemc-v160-alpha3-to-50-immersivemc-v160-alpha4).

releases.notes:
This quick release fixes a couple issues introduced with ImmersiveMC 1.6.0 Alpha 3:

- For all Minecraft versions, fixed the chest lid changes crashing on dedicated servers. Whoops!
- Fixed the ender chest not making sounds when opened or closed immersively.
- For 26.1.2 (and future Minecraft versions), added world upgrading for worlds carried over from previous Minecraft versions due to the moving around of world files between 1.21.11 and 26.1, ensuring items stored in Immersives aren't lost.
    - Note that this does apply to worlds that have already been opened, so lost items will be recovered.
    - If items were present in both the previous Minecraft version and when playing with ImmersiveMC 1.6.0 Alpha 3 on Minecraft 26.1.2, items from the previous Minecraft version are prioritized on a per-Immersive/per-player basis. For example, if a crafting table stored items in both 1.21.11 and in 26.1.2, the items from 1.21.11 are prioritized, and the items from ImmersiveMC 1.6.0 Alpha 3 permanently lost. This was done since ImmersiveMC 1.6.0 Alpha 3 has not been out for long. Note also that items currently present take higher priority over previous versions.
- Fixed ImmersiveMC showing a very incorrect version number in 26.1.2.

Minimizes the need to interact with GUIs in Minecraft!

Works great both in and out of VR!

Requires the MC VR API mod if you want to use this the best in VR!

Thanks to NahNotFox for the bundle bag model (the default) and the written book texture!

Thanks to:
- andreiqwer for adding support for resizing item guides and a bugfix!
- Blocker226 for fixing Z-fighting issues on several Immersives!
- yaosiqian for Simplified Chinese translations!
- Yermak for the Russian translations!
- DadoSpeedy for the German translations!
- Detective Scar for the Dutch translations!

Thanks to the Vivecraft developers for inspiration for the backpack, and to various members of the ImmersiveMC Discord for ideas!

Thanks to the guide from leo3418 for the original config screen implementation!

releases.notes:
## Minor Changes
- Chests can now be closed from any side when opened Immersively from clicking the top.

## Bug Fixes

- Fixes the game crashing when holding some buckets on Forge and NeoForge.
- Fixes immersively blocking with a shield breaking the main-hand item when the off-hand shield breaks from durability loss.
- Fixes open URL book events on 1.21.1 with the written book and lectern Immersives.
- Fixes the server being able to force the bag enabled when the client has it disabled and vice-versa.
- Fixes some cauldron interactions not working on Minecraft versions 1.21.1 and above.
- Fixes the reach behind bag option skipping the bag's config check.
